pieces.Text: A Great Old One does not need to eat, drink, or breathe, nor does it age. A Great Old One that is slain does not truly die-rather, it is forced into an extended period of dormancy that can last years, centuries, or longer. Exact details of this vary and are described in individual creature entries. Methods to permanently slay a Great Old One might exist, but such methods have yet to be learned by mortals.
